before all of life’s joys escape us. What the Hell! You've got hands and feet, a head and a pair of balls! Use them! Just because I enjoy something, does that mean it’s any the less mine? If I can afford to keep six stallions, doesn’t that mean their strength is a part of me? I race along, and what a man I’ve become, all twenty-four feet of me! So wake up, why don’t you? Let’s put rumination to bed, and come with me! I'll introduce you to the world! All this theorizing makes you like a donkey on a barren heath, led round and round by an evil spirit, while splendid green meadows surround you on every side.

@@U00494@@
How do we go about it?

@@U00496@@
By leaving. It’s that simple. By escaping this torture chamber. What kind of a life is this, boring yourself and those poor young men, your students? From here on you leave that to your potbellied neighbor! Why waste time threshing straw? Besides, all the best things you know they wouldn’t let you tell the poor lads in any case. Which reminds me, I hear one outside in the hall.

@@U00498@@
No, I can’t possibly see him,
translation:
@@U00492@@
在生活中所有的快乐都离我们而去之前。我勒个去！你有手、脚、头和一对球！使用它们！仅仅因为我喜欢某样东西，是否就意味着它不再是我的了？如果我养得起六匹种马，那不是说它们的力量就是我的一部分吗？我一路奔跑，我已经成为一个多么伟大的人了，我的身高只有二十四英尺！所以醒醒吧，为什么不呢？让我们把沉思放到床上吧，跟我来吧！我会把你介绍给这个世界！所有这些理论让你就像荒原上的一头驴子，被邪恶的灵魂牵着，绕来绕去，而周围都是美丽的绿色草地。

@@U00494@@
我们该怎么做呢？

@@U00496@@
通过离开。就是这么简单。逃离这个酷刑室。这是一种什么样的生活，让你自己和那些可怜的年轻人、你的学生感到无聊？从现在开始，你把它留给你的大腹便便的邻居！为什么要浪费时间打秸秆呢？此外，你知道的所有最好的事情无论如何他们都不会让你告诉那些可怜的小伙子。这让我想起，我听到大厅外面有声音。

@@U00498@@
不，我不可能见到他，
